text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear stance with conditional support","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay stays centered on a defendable position and repeatedly qualifies when it would accept driverless cars, which makes its argument more controlled and purposeful."},{"evidence":"“if driverless cars were available today... as long as there was an option”","quality":"nuanced claim","description":"The essay distinguishes between fully driverless use and optional driver control, showing a more developed and specific position."},{"evidence":"“I could take naps on long roadtrips... save money then I'm all for it”","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay gives multiple reasons for its stance, connecting convenience and cost to the writer’s conclusion rather than relying on a single simple point."},{"evidence":"“the people making these things need to do a little tweaking”","quality":"solution orientation","description":"The essay does not just criticize or praise the technology; it suggests improvements that would make the proposal more acceptable."},{"evidence":"“If driverless cars can help me afford what's really important to me”","quality":"organization","description":"The essay moves through distinct points in a coherent progression, making the argument easier to follow from introduction to conclusion."}]}
